content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualifications and relevant professional experience as mentioned in the official notification are eligible to apply for these Manager posts. Manager - Renewable Energy (RE): Candidates with relevant qualifications and experience in the Renewable Energy sector as per NGEL requirements.
